description: Local proxy that intercepts real DeepSeek requests from Copilot Chat and shows today's cost, token usage, and balance in the status bar (UTC).
config.statusBarFormat: Status bar display format: full (cost + tokens), cost, tokens, totalT (total tokens only), totalCost (total cost only), or balance (account balance).
config.title: DeepSeek Status Bar for Copilot
config.autoStart: Automatically start the proxy when VS Code launches.
config.manageBaseUrl: Point deepseek-copilot.baseUrl at the local proxy while running, and restore it when stopped.
config.pricing: Per-model price overrides (yuan per million tokens): an object keyed by model, each value {cache_hit, cache_miss, output}. Merged over the built-in defaults, taking priority for all historical and future dates.
config.holidays: Chinese statutory holidays (Beijing calendar days, YYYY-MM-DD): these days are off-peak all day. Defaults to 2026-09-25~27 (Mid-Autumn) and 2026-10-01~07 (National Day). The list replaces the built-in one, so remove entries you want to bill at peak.
config.additionalWorkdays: Make-up workdays (Beijing calendar days, YYYY-MM-DD): weekends that are official working days in China, so peak hours apply. Defaults to 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-10. Set to [] if you prefer weekends to always stay off-peak.
config.currency: Cost display currency: cny (￥) or usd ($).
config.cnyPerUsd: Fallback CNY per 1 USD for USD display, used when the live rate can't be fetched from the API.
config.lowBalanceWarnCny: Account balance (yuan) below which the status bar shows a low-balance warning. Set to 0 to disable.
config.recentRequestsCount: Number of recent requests shown in the detail panel.
